title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Evidence-state composition is closed at 50/50, and the primary anti-circularity M2 model is now frozen to five non-definitional condition families. A pre-calibration readiness audit fails at 19/50 complete cases, so calibration and all QCA solutions remain closed pending targeted acquisition.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the sample, evidence ontology and anti-circularity ladder before analysis. After five blinded evidence batches, M2 condition families were frozen before any result inspection. Measurement-equivalence review replaced provisional INTERNAL_ACTIVITY with INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION/differentiation in the primary model, while geology/ocean/tidal heating were frozen as sensitivity families. Current readiness fails at 19/50 complete cases; calibration remains CLOSED_NOT_READY.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence + M2 readiness
